name: Die Stal Restaurant
address: OP6b R102, Voorbrug, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Country-style dining in a historic stable setting between George and Great Brak River.
description_long:
Die Stal Restaurant brings rustic charm to the Garden Route, housed in a converted stable just off the R102 near Great Brak River. The atmospheric setting pairs exposed beams and country character with honest, hearty fare that locals have come to trust.

The menu focuses on generous portions and familiar favourites done well, from flame-grilled steaks to traditional South African comfort dishes. It's the kind of place where families gather for Sunday lunch and friends meet for relaxed weekend meals. The country setting offers a peaceful escape from the N2, with ample parking and an easy-going vibe that welcomes everyone from road-trippers to regulars.

Located conveniently between George and the coast, Die Stal makes a worthwhile detour whether you're exploring the Garden Route or looking for a reliable local spot. The friendly service and unpretentious approach have earned it a steady following among those who appreciate good food without the fuss.
